"AMHARC ÁLAINN" - IRISH FOR "BEAUTIFUL VIEW" IS PERCHED ON AN ELEVATED SITE IN GLEANN LOIC DUNQUIN. THIS EXCEPTIONAL FOUR-BEDROOM RESIDENCE (FOUR EN-SUITE WITH AN INDEPENDENT WET ROOM AND TOILET) ENJOYS SPECTACULAR UNINTERRUPTED VIEWS OF THE BLASKET ISLANDS AND THE DRAMIATIC ATLANTIC COASTLINE.
PRESENTED IN IMMACULATE CONDITION AND BEING SOLD SUBSTANTIALLY FURNISHED, "AMHARC ÁLAINN" IS TRULY A TURN-KEY PROPERTY, OFFERING BOTH COMFORT AND STYLE IN ONE OF IRELAND'S MOST SCENIC LOCATIONS.
A UNIQUE FEATURE OF THE PROPERTY IS THAT ONE OF THE FIRST-FLOOR BEDROOMS FORMS PART OF A SELF-CONTAINED UNIT WITH ITS OWN INDEPENDENT ACCESS. THIS PROVIDES AN EXCELLENT OPPORTUNITY TO GENERATE RENTAL INCOME WHILE RETAINING FULL ENJOYMENT OF THE MAIN RESIDENCE.
THE PROPERTY COMBINES PRIVACY, TRANQUILLITY AND BREATHTAKING SCENERY, YET REMAINS CONVENIENTLY LOCATED. KRUGER'S PUB REPUTEDLY THE MOST WESTERLY PUB IN EUROPE, IS JUST 600 METRES AWAY AND SERVES FOOD, WHILE THE RENOWNED BLUE FLAG BEACH AT VENTRY IS ONLY 5.5.KM (APPROXIMATELY 3.5 MILES) ACROSS THE MOUNTAIN.
FOR THOSE SEEKING UNRIVALLED VIEWS, PRIVACY AND A HOME READY FOR IMMEDIATE OCCUPATION, "AMHARC ÁLAINN" IS A RARE OPPORTUNITY NOT TO BE MISSED.
